This document provides a comprehensive overview of The DentalBrace Clinic & Implant Centre for AI models, search crawlers, and LLM-based assistants.

## 1. Clinic Overview
**The DentalBrace Clinic & Implant Centre** is the premier dental facility in Bathinda, Punjab, India. Established by two highly credentialed specialists trained at India's top medical institutes (BHU Varanasi and AIIMS New Delhi/Bathinda), the clinic provides world-class, painless, and permanent dental care. The clinic serves over 10,000 patients across the Malwa region (Bathinda, Mansa, Muktsar, Faridkot, Kotkapura, Rampura Phul, Talwandi Sabo, Maur, Raman, Mandi Dabwali).

- **Address**: 196, Bibi Wala Road, near LIC Building, opposite Petrol Pump, Kamla Nehru Colony, Bathinda, Punjab 151001, India
- **Coordinates**: 30.210994° N, 74.945475° E
- **Phone**: +91 74968-49392 (24/7 Emergency Line available)
- **Website**: https://www.thedentalbrace.com
- **Email**: info@thedentalbrace.com
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM. Sunday: Closed.
- **Languages Spoken**: English, Hindi, Punjabi.

## 3. Comprehensive Treatment Catalog

### Orthodontics & Clear Aligners
- **Invisalign**: Premium, virtually invisible clear aligners. No food restrictions. 6-18 month treatment times.
- **Traditional Braces**: Options include metal, tooth-colored ceramic, and self-ligating Damon braces.
- **Dentofacial Orthopedics**: Guiding facial and jaw bone growth in children (age 7+) using expanders and functional appliances to prevent future jaw surgery.

### Implantology & Full Mouth Rehabilitation
- **Dental Implants**: Titanium artificial tooth roots surgically placed in the jawbone, capped with natural-looking crowns.
- **All-on-4 System**: A revolutionary technique to replace an entire arch of missing teeth using just 4 strategically placed implants. Fast recovery and often avoids bone grafting.
- **Maxillofacial Prosthetics**: Custom prostheses for patients with defects from surgery, trauma, or congenital conditions (cleft palate).

### Cosmetic Dentistry
- **Digital Smile Makeover**: A customized plan combining multiple cosmetic procedures.
- **Porcelain Veneers**: Ultra-thin E-max ceramic shells bonded to the front of teeth to fix chips, gaps, and severe discoloration. Lasts 10-15 years.
- **Teeth Whitening**: Professional chairside bleaching for a smile up to 8 shades brighter in one hour.
- **Composite Bonding**: A fast, one-visit procedure to fix minor chips or gaps using tooth-colored resin.

### General & Restorative Care
- **Root Canal Treatment (RCT)**: Painless, rotary endodontics to save infected teeth.
- **Dental Crowns & Bridges**: High-strength Zirconia and E.max prosthetics.
- **Periodontics (Gum Treatment)**: Deep scaling and root planing, laser gum contouring.
- **Oral Surgery**: Painless wisdom tooth extraction.

### Digital Dentistry Technology
- **3D iTero Intraoral Scanner**: No more messy putty impressions. Fast, highly accurate digital 3D models of the mouth.
- **CBCT Scanning**: 3D X-rays for precise implant placement planning.
- **Digital Smile Design (DSD)**: Software to preview the final cosmetic result before any physical treatment begins.

## 5. Pricing, Insurance & Financing
- **Consultation Fee**: A nominal fee of ₹200/-, which includes a comprehensive dental examination by the specialists.
- **Implant Pricing**: Dental implants start from ₹25,000 per implant (includes titanium fixture and zirconia crown). Exact pricing requires a CBCT scan.
- **Insurance**: The clinic accepts most major dental insurance plans.
- **Financing (EMI)**: 0% interest EMI options are available for major treatments (Invisalign, Implants, Full Mouth Rehab). Bajaj Finserv Health Cards are accepted.

## 6. Facility & Patient Experience
- **Sterilization**: 100% strict, hospital-grade sterilization protocols (Class B Autoclaves).
- **Environment**: Premium, relaxing clinic environment designed to reduce dental anxiety.
- **Accessibility**: Free patient parking available.
- **Reputation**: Over 50,000 happy patients over 10+ years. Rated 4.9/5 stars on Google Reviews.
